t: Real Research Today: Cargo Drone Highways 2.0
title: Real Research Today: Cargo Drone Highways 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Cargo Drone Highways 2.0.
description:
The road to Cargo Drone Highways 2.0 is already being paved. The EU's SESAR and US NextGen modernize air-traffic control for denser skies. Autonomous shipping trials (Yara Birkeland, MAS) test crewless cargo vessels.

Hydrogen aviation programs (Airbus ZEROe, Universal Hydrogen) fly fuel-cell regional aircraft. Together these programs form the cargo drones foundation that Cargo Drone Highways 2.0 will build on — the highway logistics results, the beyond-visual-line methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as highway logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where cargo drones monitoring, highway logistics redundancy, or beyond-visual-line maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Cargo Drone Highways 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Cargo Drone Highways 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Cargo Drone Highways 2.0 — next-gen dedicated cargo drone routes.

Phase 1 — Prove (cargo drones): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (highway logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (beyond-visual-line): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (sorting hubs): highway hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and logistics-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
